sources.observation: Tall stepped andesite crowns have projecting weathered bands and tiers of ratna finials. Deep openings sit behind framed portals on platforms reached by stone stairs.

limitations: The eight named temple footprints are map matched. Some marker shrine positions and the wall crest use approximations from the court plan and visible stonework.
Terrarium establishes approximate grades at the tower bases. Carved scenes, stair details and the portions of the upper stone ornament that are hard to resolve in photographs use simplified geometry.
The outer Perwara court and the nearby temple sites remain separate map features.
